entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-07
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Random failure: System.MissingMethodException: Method not found: 'UInt32 System.Reflection.Metadata.Ecma335.HasConstantTag.ConvertToTag(System.Reflection.Metadata.EntityHandle)'. #79826
  • Roslyn rule succeeded when it should have failed #79824
  • Compiler generates seemingly unused class for extensions? #79823
  • There is a call to ```BindSimpleBinaryOperator``` in ```Binder.RebindSimpleBinaryOperatorAsConverted``` it is unlikely that it is ever going to take advantage of extension operators, but we need to confirm that. If extension can be used there, tests coverage should be added. #79820
